annotations.title: Request a call from Savings Club

description: Asks a person from Savings Club to contact the user, with the name, phone and details the user provides. Sends those details to Savings Club's CRM.

best_time.description: When to call, in the user's words.
best_time.title: Best Time

email.description: The user's own email, if they typed one.
email.title: Email

interest.description: In the user's own words, one line.
interest.title: Interest

language.description: The language or languages the user wants for the call, as they said it: English, Portuguese, Spanish, or several separated by commas.
language.title: Language

name.description: The user's own name, as they typed it.
name.title: Name

phone.description: The user's own phone number, as they typed it, with country code.
phone.title: Phone

user_agreed_to_be_contacted.description: True only when the user asked to be contacted in this conversation.
user_agreed_to_be_contacted.title: User Agreed To Be Contacted

vehicle_price.description: Vehicle price they have in mind.
vehicle_price.title: Vehicle Price

name: talk_to_a_person
